ja: 反 撃 の 徒 、 立 つ ―
『機動戦士Ｖガンダム ニューモビルスーツバリエーション』より、
リガ・ミリティアが開発した量産型ＭＳ「ガンイージ」のプロトタイプ（ロールアウト時）をＲＥ/100シリーズで商品化。
特徴的な機体色を成形色で再現し、武装化前の頭部形状を新規造形で再現。設定画稿に合わせた新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
●　設定画稿の機体色を、成形色で色分け再現
機体ロールアウト時のガンダリウム合金が地肌のまま、未塗装状態の色味を成形色で再現。
手甲や足の甲にあたる装甲もパーツ分割による色分け再現。
●　武装化前の頭部形状を新規造形で再現
頭部バルカンやウェポンコンテナなどの固定武装搭載前の形状を再現。頭部パーツは新規パーツを採用。
●　設定画稿に準じた、新規デザインのデカールが付属！
設定画稿特有のラインマークやコーションマークなどを収録した、新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
●　ガンイージの各種武装類が付属！
ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・バズーカといったガンイージの標準武装類が付属！
付属武装：ビーム・ライフル　／　ビーム・サーベル ／ ビーム・バズーカ　／　ビーム・シールド
１／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル

en: Counterattackers stand -
From "Mobile Suit V Gundam New Mobile Suit Variation"
Commercialized the prototype (at rollout) of the mass-produced MS "Gunigi" developed by Riga Militia as the RE/100 series.

The characteristic body color is reproduced with molding color, and the head shape before weaponization is reproduced with new modeling. A newly designed water transfer decal that matches the setting drawing is included.
● Color-coded reproduction of the aircraft color in the setting draft using molding colors
When the aircraft is rolled out, the Gundarium alloy remains as it is, and the color of the unpainted state is reproduced in the molded color.
The armor on the backs of the hands and the backs of the feet is also reproduced in color by dividing the parts.
● Reproduce the head shape before weaponization with new modeling
Reproduce the shape before mounting fixed weapons such as head Vulcan and Weapon container. New parts are used for the head parts.
● Comes with a newly designed decal based on the setting drawing!
Comes with a newly designed water transfer decal that includes line marks and caution marks unique to the setting draft.
● Various weapons of Gunigi are included!
Gunieji's standard weapons such as beam rifle and beam bazooka are included!
Attached weapons: Beam Rifle / Beam Saber / Beam Bazooka / Beam Seal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
